final_answer:
Meta's revenue grew from $134,902M in FY2023 to $164,501M in FY2024 [DOC-1], a growth rate of approximately 21.9% (($164,501M − $134,902M) / $134,902M).

Amazon's net sales grew from $574,785M in FY2023 to $637,959M in FY2024 [DOC-1], a growth rate of approximately 11.0% (($637,959M − $574,785M) / $574,785M).

Note on comparability: Meta reports this line item as "revenue," while Amazon reports it as "net sales" — both represent top-line sales figures and are broadly comparable for growth-rate purposes, though the underlying business models (advertising-driven vs. retail/cloud) differ substantially, so the drivers of growth are not directly comparable in nature.

Meta's revenue growth rate (~21.9%) exceeded Amazon's net sales growth rate (~11.0%) by approximately 10.9 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.9 percentage points (21.9% vs. 11.0%)
